title: Generated imported-LTYPE edit preserves application metadata and complex segments
scope: One locally generated AC1027 LTYPE profile through libdxfrw DXF import, caller edit, and ASCII/Binary export plus fresh typed readback for seven target revisions.

sourceProfile.origin: generated locally by libdxfrw test code; no external drawing fixture

readbackAssertions: edited description and dash lengths override imported values
name, alignment, element count and total pattern length remain coherent
ordered complex text element fields remain present with updated first length
application-data opener, payload and closer remain unchanged

binding.result: PASS 1/1 in 0.82 seconds; one generated imported-and-edited LTYPE verifies ASCII and Binary outputs at all seven supported DXF revisions (14 target/encoding combinations).

limitations: This is generated codec and typed-readback evidence for one source profile, not a LibreCAD application/adapter regression run.
It does not establish native AutoCAD or other consumer acceptance, other LTYPE metadata groups, arbitrary complex elements, or producer interoperability.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added to the repository.
